Step one

AI Act Readiness Check

Before you commit to a full assessment, find out how big the question actually is. Ninety minutes of our time, a five-page document, and a clear view of where you stand.

What you get

A short, honest read on your exposure.

Most organisations we speak to are not asking us to fix anything yet. They are asking a simpler question: does this regulation apply to us, and how badly? The Readiness Check answers that question and nothing more.

  • ✓ An inventory of the AI systems your organisation actually uses — including the ones adopted without IT or legal review.
  • ✓ A preliminary categorisation of each system against the EU AI Act risk tiers, with the reasoning shown.
  • ✓ The three actions we would prioritise first, with an indication of effort and urgency for each.

This is a preliminary view, not a legal opinion and not a substitute for a full assessment. Where the categorisation is genuinely uncertain, we say so rather than guessing.

How it runs

  1. 01

    A 90-minute working session

    One call with whoever knows how your teams actually work — usually an operations, IT, or leadership contact. No preparation required, no documents to assemble in advance.

  2. 02

    We do the analysis

    We take what came out of the session and map it against the EU AI Act risk categories and the obligations that appear to follow from them.

  3. 03

    You get a five-page document

    Delivered within 3 business days. Written in plain language, addressed to a decision-maker rather than a lawyer.

Start here if…

  • →You know your teams use AI tools, but nobody has written down which ones.
  • →Someone has asked whether the EU AI Act applies to you, and the honest answer is that nobody is sure.
  • →You want to know the size of the problem before committing to a full assessment.
  • →You need something concrete to bring to a board or management meeting.

If you already have an AI system inventory and know which systems are in scope, skip this and go straight to the full assessment. If you are not sure this is the right step at all, the free AI Act Quick Check takes three minutes and costs nothing.
